description:
## What

New workspace crate `pkix-zlint-bridge`. Std-only. Provides shared subprocess plumbing and result-parsing infrastructure for running zlint on certificates, consumed by:

- `pkix-policy-zlint` (PKIX-jy95.1 area) — runtime adapter exposing zlint findings as workspace Lint impls
- `pkix-difftest`'s zlint oracle (PKIX-hbzo.1) — differential testing against zlint's verdicts

## Scope

- Subprocess spawn (zlint binary on PATH or configured path)
- Stdin/stdout/stderr handling
- Exit code interpretation
- NDJSON output parsing (zlint -format json)
- Verdict vocabulary normalization (NA / NE / pass / notice / warn / error / fatal)
- BridgeError type covering binary-not-found / version-mismatch / malformed-output / subprocess-crash
- Single-cert and batch entry points (batch is mandatory per AGENTS.md non-negotiable #6)
- Test fixtures sourced from zlint's own testdata (Apache-2.0, citable)

## Cross-references

- PKIX-jy95.6 (decision that filed this crate)
- PKIX-jy95.1 / .2 / .3 / .4 (open shape decisions that now scope to THIS crate's API)
- PKIX-hbzo.1 (consumer; differential oracle)
- AGENTS.md non-negotiable #6 (cache-friendly types, batch API mandatory)

## Open shape decisions inherited

These decisions now scope to this bridge crate, not the pkix-policy-zlint adapter:

- PKIX-jy95.1 — granularity (per-check Finding vs umbrella Finding)
- PKIX-jy95.2 — severity mapping (zlint Verdict -> workspace Severity)
- PKIX-jy95.3 — batch interface shape (stdin streaming / file-per-cert / array)
- PKIX-jy95.4 — error-handling policy

## Open shape decisions added at bridge level

- Sync vs async: default sync; async via separate trait or fn if needed (matches pkix-revocation / pkix-revocation-http precedent where sync is core and async is additive)
- zlint version pinning: which zlint version(s) does the bridge support? Pin a minimum; refuse older with helpful error.
- Test corpus: vendor zlint's testdata/ or fetch on demand?

## Out of scope

- Implementing pkix-policy-zlint or pkix-difftest's oracle (separate beads).
- Cgo / FFI integration (per PKIX-jy95 Mark 2026-05-12: subprocess/IPC only, FFI not preferred).
- Pkilint coverage — pkix-pkilint-bridge is a separate sibling crate (PKIX-jy95.8).

## Acceptance

- [ ] Crate exists in workspace Cargo.toml as a published library
- [ ] Subprocess plumbing with configurable zlint path
- [ ] NDJSON parsing for zlint -format json output
- [ ] Verdict normalization to a workspace-shaped Verdict enum
- [ ] BridgeError satisfies non-negotiable #6
- [ ] Single-cert + batch entry points
- [ ] Cargo feature 'serde' enables Serialize/Deserialize derives
- [ ] Test fixtures cite their zlint testdata source
- [ ] CHANGELOG + AGENTS.md inventory entry
title: Create pkix-zlint-bridge crate (shared subprocess + parsing infrastructure for zlint)
